title: USGS prediction of a La Palma collapse tsunami
place_text: La Palma Island; US East Coast

tellings.quote: And uh the US Geological Service has predicted that uh that would cause a tsunami that in some places would wipe out up to 26 miles inland on the east US coast.

plain: A collapse on the island of La Palma could set off a tsunami that would reach up to 26 miles inland in places on the US East Coast. That is the prediction Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, credits to the US Geological Survey, the American government's earth science agency. He gives it from memory, without naming a specific report, as a warning of what such an event would mean for the coast.
